The nearest documented Nath shrines are at Chirimiri (~270 km, Chhattisgarh) and the famous Gorakhnath Math at Gorakhpur, UP (~670 km), the headquarters of the Nath order founded by Guru Gorakshanath. This file is therefore a clearly-flagged placeholder: presumably a local Nath-tradition shrine to Guru Gorakhnath, but its exact location, age and identity could not be verified. No festival is documented for this site (Nath shrines typically observe Makar Sankranti, Mahashivratri and Guru Purnima, but that is the Gorakhpur Math's calendar, not confirmed here). Coordinates are Rajnandgaon city as an approximation, and media is empty because no reliable on-topic image exists. Do not plan travel on this entry without local verification.

name: Gorakhnath Temple
town_description: Rajnandgaon, headquarters of its district on the Mumbai-Howrah rail route, is a commercial and cultural centre of western Chhattisgarh. Its old quarters cluster around historic ponds such as Rani Sagar and Budha Sagar, and it lies about 70 km from Raipur.

travel.railway: Rajnandgaon Junction, on the Mumbai-Howrah main line.
travel.road: Rajnandgaon city on NH-53; the shrine's exact location within the city is unconfirmed.
